conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua:2163–2170：Dethzaw 是 BASE_STEAMSAW，名字本身是 Deathsaw 的故意拼错，desc 末句“His naming skills have not improved.”点明取名笑话（本库 tome-orcs.lua:1750 已译“他的取名技巧从没有得到提高。”）。现译“死忘链据”以同音错字（忘＝亡、据＝锯）对应“死亡链锯”，是有意保留的谐音梗，不是错字；surface 与 contextual 均报错字，宿主按源码语境 refuted。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Orcs 来源仓库/commit 未固定。
公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/zones/ritch-hive/objects.lua:25–29：该物件 SAND_RITCH_EGGS，type=egg、subtype=ritch，name“pile of ritch eggs”；里奇是虫类，“虫卵”有源码依据。contextual 判 OK。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Orcs 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua:1465–1498（MIASMA）：callbackOnHit 仅在 src.turn_procs.weapon_type 存在且本回合 self.turn_procs.miasma 未置位时触发一次酸性伤害；现译“每回合第一次被带有武器类型的近战或远程攻击命中时”贴合实现，英文描述较实现宽泛。contextual 判 OK。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Orcs 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/zones/primal-forest/npcs.lua:35–37（crystalbark）：desc“A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become infected with crystalline structures.”；现译“一个强大的有智能的树精”删掉 near（近乎有灵智→已有智能）与 very（本库实体名 crystalbark＝“晶化树精”，“树精”一词本身不作缺陷）。同族 tome-orcs.lua:1718／mod-tome.lua:8645“A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become hostile…”译“一棵极为强壮的半智慧树木”。建议“一棵极为强壮的半智慧树木，已被晶体结构所侵蚀。”本批文件 SHA 匹配，Orcs 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

}


newEntity{ define_as = "PRIMAL_ROOT",
	allow_infinite_dungeon = true,
	type = "giant", subtype = "treant",
	name = "Crystallized Primal Root",
	display = "#", color=VIOLET,
	resolvers.nice_tile{tall=1},
	sound_moam = "creatures/treants/treeant_2",
	sound_die = {"creatures/treants/treeant_death_%d", 1, 2},
	sound_random = {"creatures/treants/treeant_%d", 1, 3},
	desc = _t[[This once great primal tree has been infused and corrupted by crystals growing wildly all over it. Such a terrible end.]],
	level_range = {30, nil}, exp_worth = 3 / 5,

	max_life = 300, life_rating = 20, fixed_rating = true,
	max_stamina = 200,

	combat = { dam=100, atk=10, apr=0, dammod={str=1.2}, sound="actions/melee_thud" },

	stats = { str=40, dex=10, cun=15, mag=20, wil=38, con=45 },

	rank = 4,
	size_category = 5,
	infravision = 10,
	instakill_immune = 1,
	stun_immune = 1,
	bleed_immune = 1,
	knockback_immune = 1,
	move_others = true,

	resists = { [DamageType.PHYSICAL] = 50, [DamageType.COLD] = 50, [DamageType.NATURE] = 25 },
	body = { INVEN = 10, MAINHAND=1, OFFHAND=1, BODY=1 },
	resolvers.auto_equip_filters("Brawler"),
	resolvers.drops{chance=100, nb=1, {tome_drops="boss"} },

	summon = {
		{type="immovable", subtype="crystal", number=3, hasxp=false},
		{properties={"is_treant"}, number=3, hasxp=false},
	},

	resolvers.talents{
		[Talents.T_STUN]={base=3, every=10},
		[Talents.T_GRAB]={base=3, every=10},
		[Talents.T_CLINCH]={base=3, every=10},
		[Talents.T_FROST_GRAB]={base=2, every=6, max=10},
		[Talents.T_PHANTASMAL_SHIELD]={base=2, every=6, max=10},
		[Talents.T_SUMMON]=1,
		[Talents.T_SUBCUTANEOUS_METALLISATION] = 1, 
		[Talents.T_SPINE_OF_THE_WORLD] = 1, 
		[Talents.T_MASSIVE_BLOW] = 1,
	},
	autolevel = "warriorwill",
	ai = "tactical", ai_state = { talent_in=1, ai_move="move_astar", },
	ai_tactic = resolvers.tactic"melee",
	resolvers.inscriptions(6, "infusion"),

	ingredient_on_death = "PRIMAL_CORE",

	on_die = function(self)
		game.zone.killed_roots = (game.zone.killed_roots or 0) + 1
		if game.zone.killed_roots >= 5 and not game.zone.killed_treant then
			world:gainAchievement("ORCS_MENDER", game.player)
		end
	end,
}
